symptom: describe page -> create or replace page broke a button's icon. An icon into an IMAGE collection came back as `Icon: 'DesignSystem.Icons_SVG.edit'` and the build failed [CE1613] "The selected custom icon 'DesignSystem.Icons_SVG.edit' no longer exists." A GLYPH icon produced no describe output at all -- no clause, no comment -- and replay DELETED it at exit 0.
cause: Mendix stores three icon elements and two put a qualified name under the same BSON key: Forms$IconCollectionIcon{Image}->CustomIcons$CustomIcon, Forms$ImageIcon{Image}->Images$Image, Forms$GlyphIcon{Code}. extractIconRef read `Image` off whichever element was there and threw the $Type away, and the page builder writes Forms$IconCollectionIcon unconditionally -- so the two named variants were spelled identically on the way out and collapsed into one on the way back in.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_output.go (extractButtonIcon, widgetIconMDL, widgetIconNote), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe.go (rawWidget.IconType/IconCode), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go; tests mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_icon_test.go
insight: The identical three-variant defect was fixed in NAVIGATION eight days earlier (2026-09-05, same area file) and the page path never received it -- so the cheapest possible diagnosis was `grep MenuIconKindOf`, and the fix reuses that resolver rather than adding a second one. **Generalisable: when a fix teaches a layer to distinguish polymorphic variants, grep for every OTHER reader of the same element.** The find was one `git grep Forms\$ImageIcon` away all along. Two things the report got understandably wrong and that the fix depends on getting right: it is not about third-party vs native collections (a third-party ICON collection round-trips fine -- and CE1613 naming the reference is itself proof the name was never a custom icon, since mxbuild would otherwise have resolved it), and the reported image-icon case is the CHEAPER half -- the glyph case is silent on both sides, so nothing in the output even hints at the loss. **Measure the silence, not the wrong answer**: `grep -c icon` over describe output of a stock marketplace project's FeedbackModule pages returned 0 before and 3 after, which is the only form the glyph bug has. The note has to fire on an UNRECOGNISED $Type too, not a known-bad list, or the next variant Mendix adds is dropped the same way. Controls that matter: an icon-collection icon must still emit a bare `Icon:` and NO note (else the fix passes by flagging everything), and an iconless button must emit neither. No .mdl repro is possible -- mxcli cannot author an image or glyph icon on a button, so the input to the round trip cannot be constructed in MDL; the reproduction is a stored-widget map in the unit test. Also observed in passing and NOT fixed: a nameless `statictext` makes describe output unparseable (pre-existing, confirmed against the base binary), and NavigationList item / DropDownButton icons are never read at all, so they are dropped as silently as the glyph was.
